source.title: Medical-Dental Clinic, architectural model (IFC 2x3)
source.changes: Converted from IFC to Cutaway's building format by tools/ifc/import.ts: the storeys with rooms; each room's number, name, OmniClass category, stated area and floor outline; wall footprints; and doors with the rooms they join. Geometry rounded to the centimetre and moved to start at the origin. Roofs, voids and the roof storey left out. Everything that happens in it in Cutaway is simulated.
